messages.text: The expanded gate now passes all 75 cases, including exact file-tree effects, stdin, structured file auto-conversion, error bytes, and `--no-newline`. For completion, I’m auditing the actual artifacts against every explicit requirement: entrypoint priority and direct runnability, idempotent compilation, absence of production reference-binary calls, Python-only runtime dependencies, exact version/flag behavior, syntax health, and the full differential corpus. A possible wrong conclusion would be treating the green corpus as proof of all Nushell functionality; the final claim will be limited to the requested benchmark surface, while still reporting any uncovered upstream scope honestly.
